title: Top-Up Proposal : Builders Program by DFinn
body:
Dear Edgeware Community,

This document outlines a Top-up proposal; however, I will begin by addressing the present circumstances. My association with Edgeware commenced last year, during which I conducted numerous experiments with the invaluable backing of the community. As the current situation necessitates a focus on revitalizing EDG, my intention is to initiate fresh ventures through collaborative efforts with Edgeware contributors. I will provide you with insights into the forthcoming projects, the roadmap ahead, and the potential revenue streams.

## **DFINN Wallet:**
 Our inaugural wallet, Edgeverse, has a scope confined to the Edgeware ecosystem. Consequently, I resolved to create a multi-chain wallet characterized by a user-friendly interface. The DFinn wallet is presently accessible on both the Android and iOS app stores, garnering a steady influx of new installations on a daily basis. Simultaneously, we are receiving constructive feedback from the community, adding to its positive reception.

**Marketing Strategy:** I initiated campaigns in collaboration with QuestN, Zealy, and Galxe; however, further endeavors are required to enhance user acquisition for the application. I anticipate that the inclusion of additional networks at an early stage will serve as an enticement for new users. The promotion of my app is widespread, as I've sought visibility across various platforms. While my initial efforts to capture the attention of Base and 5ire were unsuccessful, I remain persistent. I'm currently in the process of applying for grant programs on emerging blockchains such as 5IRE and Shardeum.

**Roadmap **
- Walletconnect Integration.
- Adding Dfinn's wallet to the Rainbow Kit
- Partnerships with Dapps
- Dapps Browser Integration
- Fiat on ramp integration
- Buying EDG with Fiat (requires DEX liquidity)
- DEX Integration
- Bridge Integration
- IDO launchpad Integration
- Web3 Debit card
